title: Yellowed Indulgent Slovakian Fennel Paella
description: This paleo-friendly dish is a twist on traditional paella, featuring fennel bulb and a rich, cheesy flavor, with a bitter note and a satisfying cheese pull, all cooked to perfection in a paella pan using steam.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced fennel bulb and cook until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the shredded Slovakian cheese until melted and well combined.
Continue to cook, covered, for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.
